TaskLibrary.Description: Tasks of the example library, referenced by equipments, entities and units through TaskRef.

TaskDefinition.name: MoveTo
TaskDefinition.Description: Move to a geographic position, ignoring altitude.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Entity that moves. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: TravelTime
Parameter.Description: Time actually spent reaching the destination, set by the task when it ends.

Parameter.name: Destination
Parameter.Description: Point to reach. Altitude is ignored: the executor keeps its current altitude.

Parameter.name: Shooter
Parameter.Description: Entity that fires. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Weapon
Parameter.Description: Weapon of the shooter used to fire. When omitted, the shooter picks a suitable weapon.

Parameter.name: ShotsFired
Parameter.Description: Number of munitions actually fired, set by the task when it ends.

Parameter.name: Salvo
Parameter.Description: Number of munitions fired at once on each engagement.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Entity that flies the plan. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Loop
Parameter.Description: Whether the plan restarts from its first waypoint once the last one is reached.

Parameter.name: Plan
Parameter.Description: Waypoints to fly through, in order.

Parameter.name: CurrentWaypoint
Parameter.Description: Index of the waypoint flown towards. Set to choose the starting waypoint; the task updates it as each waypoint is reached.

TaskDefinition.name: ChangeFormation
TaskDefinition.Description: Change the formation of a unit.

Parameter.name: Leader
Parameter.Description: Leader of the unit. The other members take their place relative to it.

Parameter.name: Spacing
Parameter.Description: Distance between two neighbouring members of the formation.
